test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Arrange the following steps in the correct order to draw an equilateral triangle with each side of 35 mm.

1. Join CA and CB.

2. Draw a line and mark AB 35 mm as the side of the triangle.

3. With radius AB and center A and B, draw arcs cutting at C.

4. ABC is the required triangle.
solution:
The correct answer is __2, 3, 1, 4__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Step 2:__ Draw a line and mark AB 35 mm as the side of the triangle.
 
• __Step 3:__ With radius AB and center A and B, draw arcs cutting at C.
 
• __Step 1:__ Join CA and CB.
 
• __Step 4:__ ABC is the required triangle.
